;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Militants kill a [[Jammu and Kashmir Police|policeman]] and two [[paramilitary]] officers in [[Srinagar]]. A spokesman for the police says they thwarted another attack when they recovered [[improvised explosive device]]s placed under a bridge. This has been seen as an increase in attacks on security forces in recent months. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-kashmir/militants-kill-three-indian-policemen-in-kashmir-as-attacks-pick-up-idUSKCN25D0XB (Reuters)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**A [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] missile attack kills 11 [[Yemeni Armed Forces|Yemeni government troops]], including a senior officer, in [[Al Jawf Governorate|Al Jawf]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/08/11-yemen-soldiers-killed-clashes-rebel-attack-200817090656534.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 recession]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] suffers its biggest economic slump on record as its [[Economy of Japan|economy]]'s [[gross domestic product|GDP]] fell 7.8% in April-June quarter. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-53802967 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]]'s [[economy of Thailand|economy]] suffers its biggest annual contraction since the [[1997 Asian financial crisis]], with its GDP down 12.2% in the second quarter from a year earlier. It fell a record 9.7% on the quarter, on a seasonally adjusted basis. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-economy-gdp/thai-second-quarter-gdp-shrinks-122-year-on-year-weakest-in-22-years-idUSKCN25D06V (Reuters)]
*[[China–United States trade war]], [[Chinese espionage in the United States]], [[Concerns over Chinese involvement in 5G wireless networks]]
**The [[United States Department of Commerce]] expands its sanctions on Chinese technological vendor [[Huawei]] by adding 38 of the company's affiliates to its "entity list", limiting Huawei's access into U.S. [[integrated circuit]]s and other technology. The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] has viewed Huawei as "an arm of the [[Chinese Communist Party]]'s [[Mass surveillance in China|surveillance state]]." [http://theindependent.sg/us-adds-sanctions-on-chinas-huawei-to-limit-technology-access/ (AFP via ''The Independent'')]
*The bankrupt [[NPC International]] announces it will close 300 [[Pizza Hut]] locations. [https://www.foxbusiness.com/lifestyle/300-pizza-hut-closing-franchisee-bankruptcy (Fox Business)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Sri Lankan blackouts]]
**[[Power cut|Electrical blackouts]] in [[Sri Lanka]] began nationwide due to a transmission technical failure at the [[Yugadanavi Power Station|Kerawalapitiya Grid-Sub station]]. [http://www.dailynews.lk/2020/08/17/local/226107/electricity-supply-island-wide-was-disrupted (''Daily News'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****The [[Basque Country (autonomous community)|Basque Country]] declares a sanitary emergency for the second time since the start of the pandemic, but doesn't foresee a general confinement of the Basque population. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/local/paisvasco/20200817/482870526999/euskadi-emergencia-sanitaria-medidas-coronavirus.html (''La Vanguardia'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****With 16 new daily confirmed cases, [[Andorra]] exceeds 1,000 cumulative confirmed cases of COVID-19 since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2020/08/17/andorra_supera_miler_casos_covid_165481_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nigeria]]
***The [[Federal Ministry of Aviation (Nigeria)|Federal Ministry of Aviation]] announces that international flights from [[Murtala Muhammed International Airport|Lagos]] and [[Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport|Abuja]] will resume on August 29, after a four-month hiatus. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/coronavirus-nigeria-set-to-resume-intl-flights/1945141 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***Australia reports 25 new COVID-19 deaths (all of them in [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]]), the deadliest day since the pandemic began. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-08-17/victoria-coronavirus-update-25-deaths-282-new-cases/12564418 (ABC News Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]], [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns]]
***[[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] downgrades the lockdown restrictions on the [[Greater Manila Area]] to the level of [[COVID-19 community quarantines in the Philippines#General community quarantine (GCQ)|general community quarantine]], effective August 19, following a two-week reimposition of a modified [[Enhanced community quarantine in Luzon|enhanced community quarantine]] to prevent a "collapse" of the country's [[Health care in the Philippines|health care system]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-philippines/philippines-promises-refreshed-coronavirus-approach-as-capital-exits-strict-lockdown-idUSKCN25D238 (Reuters)]
*The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] is pushing ahead with plans to allow drilling in the [[Arctic National Wildlife Refuge]]. The first leases to drill for oil and gas could be sold by the end of 2020, and is backed by the [[Republican Party (United States)| Republicans]] and opposed by [[Environmental movement in the United States|environmental groups]] and some members of [[Alaska]]'s [[Alaska Natives|Indigenous communities]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/08/17/politics/trump-arctic-wildlife-drilling/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*Aftermath of the [[2020 Belarusian presidential election]]
**[[Belarus–United Kingdom relations]]
***[[Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs|British Foreign Secretary]] [[Dominic Raab]] issues a statement that the [[United Kingdom]] does not recognize the results of the Belarusian presidential election, which saw [[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] re-elected. Raab calls the election "fraudulent" and demands an independent investigation into the results. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/uk-does-not-accept-results-of-belarus-election-foreign-secretary-dominic-raab (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
**[[Belarus–Ukraine relations]]
***[[Ukraine]] recalls its [[Ambassador]] to Belarus to assess "the new reality" and prospects of further bilateral relations between the two neighbouring countries. [https://in.reuters.com/article/belarus-election-ukraine/ukraine-recalls-its-ambassador-to-belarus-idINKCN25D1PU (Reuters)]
*[[Netherlands–Russia relations]]
**The Russian [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] summons the Dutch ambassador in Moscow after surveillance equipment was discovered in the vehicle of a Russian [[military attaché]] in [[The Hague]]. [https://news.cgtn.com/news/2020-08-17/Russia-summons-Dutch-diplomat-over-surveillance-device-in-car-T28Po8kVeo/index.html (CGTN)]
*[[Malaysia–Vietnam relations]], [[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea]]
**[[Vietnam]] presses [[Malaysia]] for answers after a Vietnamese fisherman was shot dead when Malaysia's [[Malaysian Coast Guard|coast guard]] attempted to inspect two Vietnamese fishing boats in waters east of [[Kelantan]] deemed to be engaged in illegal fishing. Malaysia alleged the 19 crew members aboard the boats "acted aggressively" and threw "[[incendiary devices|diesel bombs]]" when ordered to surrender. [https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3097863/south-china-sea-clash-raises-vietnam-malaysia-tensions-after (''SCMP'')]

;Law and crime
*[[George Floyd protests]]
**[[George Floyd protests in Washington (state)|George Floyd protests in Washington]]
***[[George Floyd protests in Seattle]]
****18 protesters are arrested in [[Seattle]] after a protest in the [[SoDo, Seattle|SODO]] neighborhood is declared a riot. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/08/17/us/seattle-riot-protesters-arrested/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2020 Hong Kong national security law|Hong Kong national security law]]
**Pro-democracy activist [[Sunny Cheung]] reportedly flees to the United Kingdom after reporting fears of imprisonment. [https://hongkongfp.com/2020/08/17/more-hong-kong-democrats-complain-of-being-followed-as-another-activist-reportedly-flees-city/ (HK Free Press)]
*Aftermath of the [[2020 Beirut explosions]]
**Badri Daher, the director general of the [[Lebanese Customs Administration]], is arrested amid the investigation on the storage of [[ammonium nitrate]] at the [[Port of Beirut]] for six years. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/lebanese-customs-chief-arrested-over-beirut-blast-1.5067268 (AP via CTV News)]
*A court in [[Malaysia]] jails a teenager until the [[King of Malaysia|King]]'s decision for [[arson|starting a fire]] that killed 23 people in 2017. He was not eligible for the [[capital punishment in Malaysia|death penalty]] due to being a minor at the time of the arson, the court explained. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malaysia-fire/malaysian-court-jails-teenager-for-killing-23-people-in-school-fire-idUSKCN25D17U (Reuters)] 
*Two men are charged with the death of [[Run-DMC]] member [[Jam Master Jay]] in [[Queens]], New York, United States. The killing had remained unsolved as a [[cold case]] for 18 years. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/2-men-be-charged-2002-killing-hip-hop-legend-jam-n1236965?cid=eml_nbn_20200817 (NBC News)]
*The government of Colombia offers a reward of 200M [[Colombian peso|pesos]] ($53,000; €44,000; £40,000) for information about the  four gunmen who burst into a house party and killed eight people in [[Samaniego, Nariño|Samaniego]] in [[Nariño Department]] Saturday. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-53806359 (BBC News)] 

;Politics and elections
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education]]
****[[Secretary of State for Education|Education Secretary]] [[Gavin Williamson]] announces that the [[Ofqual]] has discarded the use of an algorithm to award the final grades of [[GCE Advanced Level]] and [[General Certificate of Secondary Education]] candidates in lieu of the exams that were cancelled due to the pandemic, instead basing the qualifications on teacher-assessed grades. The decision comes after hundreds of students in [[England]] protested following the release of the Advanced Level results on August 13, which saw around 40% of teacher-predicted grades downgraded under the algorithm. [https://www.theguardian.com/education/2020/aug/17/a-levels-gcse-results-england-based-teacher-assessments-government-u-turn (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/britain-working-on-solution-to-exam-row-as-criticism-spirals?cx_testId=20&cx_testVariant=cx_4&cx_artPos=3#cxrecs_s (Reuters via ''The Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]], [[WE Charity controversy]]
***[[Bill Morneau]] resigns as Canada's [[Minister of Finance (Canada)|finance minister]] following his involvement in the [[WE Charity]] scandal. [https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/6883831/canadas-finance-minister-quits/?cs=14264 (AAP via ''The Canberra Times'')]
*[[2020 Belarusian protests]]
**President [[Alexander Lukashenko]] says he is "ready to share power in Belarus, although not under pressure from the streets". Meanwhile, opposition leader in-exile [[Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya]] urges security forces to defect to her side and says she is prepared to lead the country. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belarus-election/lukashenko-says-he-is-ready-to-share-power-in-belarus-as-protests-mount-idUSKCN25D0IJ (Reuters)]
**Addressing workers at a [[MZKT|truck factory]], Lukashenko states that there will be no fresh elections "until you kill me", he warns. He urges people to let people who want to work to work amid a general strike. He is booed and jeered by the crowd. [https://news.sky.com/story/belarus-uk-condemns-appalling-violence-against-protesters-and-does-not-accept-results-of-election-12050864 (Sky News)] [https://www.politico.eu/article/belarus-protests-alexander-lukashenko-jeered-by-workers/ (''Politico'')]
**The Belarusian [[state media]] [[National State Television and Radio Company of Belarus]] headquarters in [[Minsk]] is reportedly emptied after staff members walked out and joined the general strike. State television is still on air but only showing an empty studio with music playing in the background. [https://www.dw.com/en/belarus-television-broadcasts-empty-studio-as-state-media-joins-general-strike/a-54593079 (DW)]
*[[2020 United States presidential election]]
**The [[2020 Democratic National Convention]] begins, running until Thursday. Former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]] and [[United States Senator|Senator]] [[Kamala Harris]] are expected to be officially nominated for their party's choice for [[President of the United States|President]] and Vice President, respectively, in the upcoming election. [https://www.npr.org/2020/08/15/902507449/the-democratic-national-convention-starts-monday-heres-what-you-need-to-know (NPR)]
**In a show of bipartisan support for the Democrats national [[Ticket (election)|ticket]], four longtime Republicans gave speeches: former Ohio governor [[John Kasich]], former New Jersey governor [[Christine Whitman]], former New York congresswoman [[Susan Molinari]], and [[Quibi]] CEO [[Meg Whitman]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2020/08/17/dnc-former-republican-governors-and-gop-congresswoman-set-speak-for-biden/5600304002/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[2020 United States Postal Service crisis]]
**Congressional [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrats]] have announced investigations and hearings into allegations of widespread mail delays ahead of the coming [[2020 United States presidential election]], which many expect will see a surge in [[postal voting|mail-in voting]] due to the ongoing pandemic. [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] [[Nancy Pelosi]] is calling the House of Representatives back from recess several weeks early in order to consider legislation to address the crisis. [https://thehill.com/homenews/house/512258-pelosi-calls-for-house-to-return-this-week-over-usps-issues (''The Hill'')] [https://www.axios.com/pelosi-house-postal-service-bbce98bd-6fe5-4640-995d-6061d4767940.html (''Axios'')]
